submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production 2D game running animation, ONE independently drawn native 1024x1024 RGBA full-body sprite, frame W/01 of 16. This is an edit of the supplied identity and west-facing idle into a running pose.
Input images: image 1 definitive character identity; image 2 definitive WEST-facing idle and anatomical side reference; image 3 older WEST walk only for direction and costume (do NOT copy the static arms or pose); image 4 PRIMARY approved art style reference, character artwork/materials only, no UI.
Primary request: draw Moon Shadow Assassin Girl running toward SCREEN LEFT, exact west side view, facing left. One single complete figure on genuinely transparent background. No grid, no labels, no floor/shadow/effects.
Identity invariants: silver-lavender short bob with one ahoge; large violet eyes and round cute girl face; ivory short sleeves, indigo navy short vest and scarf with restrained warm gold moon/cloud trim, loose navy trousers, short navy gold moon-toed boots; three-petal dark-navy crescent hair ornament on her ANATOMICAL LEFT temple (near side, clearly visible when facing west), turquoise beads and blue tassels; exactly TWO silver curved crescent daggers, one in each hand with navy handles and gold/turquoise guards. Hands visibly wrap handles, no floating weapons.
Pose W/01: left/NEAR leg reaches forward toward screen left with heel just contacting the virtual ground. Right/FAR leg trails to screen right, toe finishing a push and heel lifted. Opposite arm coordination: left/NEAR arm swings BACK toward screen right, elbow bent and holding its dagger beside/back of hip; right/FAR arm swings FORWARD toward screen left, elbow bent and holding its dagger in front of lower chest, not crossing face. Both hands separately readable, dagger tips clear of boots and body. Torso leans 12 degrees toward travel left with energetic grounded stride; scarf and tassels trail right. Feet separated horizontally with clear knee and ankle bends. No full-height high-knee marching.
Fixed camera/framing: 1024 square; orthographic side camera, same scale as idle with head about 370px wide, virtual root X=512, ground Y=920; do not frame to individual limb bounds. Full silhouette with safe margins, hair top approximately y=95, head/hips centered near x=510; body is squat chibi about 2.7 heads tall. Preserve genuine running weight transfer.
Style/medium: match the supplied approved clean bright rounded Chinese Daoist Q-version high-detail hand-painted style, smooth readable silhouette, soft painted volumes and light warm metal edge highlights; no 3D plastic, no photoreal skin, no hard anime cel flattening.
Avoid: mirrored identity, wrong hair ornament side, missing or extra limbs/fingers/weapons, intersecting hands, duplicated blades, extra earrings, detached projectiles, motion blur, background pixels, contact shadow, text, watermark.
